name: What is involved in cabinet installation coordination?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in cabinet installation coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cabinet installation coordination involves managing all aspects of getting your new cabinets from design to final placement. This typically includes scheduling delivery, ensuring the site is prepared, coordinating with other trades like plumbers or electricians, and overseeing the installation process itself. For Frasheski Construction, this means we aim to integrate cabinet installation seamlessly into your overall renovation project, minimizing disruptions and ensuring a cohesive timeline with other scheduled work, such as countertop installation or appliance hookups.
acceptedAnswer.description: Cabinet installation coordination manages the entire process from delivery to final placement, including scheduling, site prep, and coordinating with other trades for a smooth project.
